# function: get_tag

Returns the tag object `{ turbonomic_optimized_by = "turbonomic-terraform-provider" }`. Apply this tag to cloud resources so Turbonomic can identify them as managed by the Terraform provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Emit the tag object directly
output "turbonomic_tag" {
  value = provider::turbonomic::get_tag()
}
```
